name: Club Diamantino
description: Club Diamantino presents an event at Pérola Negra, featuring a lineup of DJs including MEIBI, Maria Callapez, Catarina Silva, and Dj Princesa. The music styles will include Progressive House, Breakbeat, Acid House, Techno, House, and Progressive Trance.
longDescription:
Club Diamantino is hosting an event at Pérola Negra, located at Rua de Gonçalo Cristóvão 284, 4000-145 Porto. The event is scheduled for Friday, November 6, 2026, starting at 11:59 PM and running until 6:00 AM.

The lineup for the night includes MEIBI, Maria Callapez, Catarina Silva, and Dj Princesa. Attendees can expect a mix of electronic music genres, such as Progressive House, Breakbeat, Acid House, Techno, House, and Progressive Trance.

Tickets are available for €10.00. Early bird tickets were sold out at €8.00, and a second wave of tickets will be on sale soon. Tickets can be resold on Shotgun if needed.

O alinhamento para a noite inclui MEIBI, Maria Callapez, Catarina Silva e Dj Princesa. Os participantes podem esperar uma mistura de géneros de música eletrónica, como Progressive House, Breakbeat, Acid House, Techno, House e Progressive Trance.
